messages:
maria: Opened a PR to clean up SOC2 audit guidance: clarified retention language, added export/redaction SDK examples, and fixed one broken anchor in the CLI docs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/513
dan: quick pass — looks good. A couple of asks: 1) make it explicit which roles can trigger exports/hold; 2) call out that exports are immutable snapshots and do not change tenant TTLs.
maria: good point. Drafted: 'Exports are immutable snapshots of audit data at the time of request. Exporting does not alter the configured retention TTL for stored logs.' thinking of adding an RBAC sentence: 'Only Organization Admins and users with the Compliance role may request exports, initiate legal holds, or modify retention settings.'
asha: +1 on that RBAC wording. For the SDK snippets, can we include a small error example when PII redaction is requested but not available? Customers asked about failure modes.
maria: added a short Ruby + TypeScript example and an error snippet showing 422 + body: {"error": "redaction_not_configured"}. Ruby snippet uses snake_case as in our style guide.
legal-lead: wording looks good overall. Two legal asks: 1) replace 'permanent' with 'indefinite' when we mean no scheduled deletion; 2) link to internal retention policy doc for auditors: https://internal/legal/retention-policy. Also include a one-sentence description of the legal-hold release workflow.
maria: switched to 'indefinite' and added the internal link + one-sentence workflow: 'When a legal hold is placed, deletion is suspended until the hold is released by Legal; release requests are recorded in the audit trail.'
dan: on the migration guide point — some customers will need a mapping table for legacy keys. I added a small JSON mapping example and a note about preserving legacy event_ids for traceability.
maria: included a three-row mapping table and a sample migration curl command. Also fixed the CLI docs anchor from /docs/cli/export to /docs/cli#audit-export and updated the in-repo anchor to match.
cli-bot: PR 513 updated. Lint passed, link-check run: 1 broken anchor fixed, 0 remaining.
maria: will merge after legal confirms the internal link text is fine. Thanks all :raised_hands:
